descripcion_geo: Coastal region of southeastern Asia Minor (present-day Türkiye), between the Taurus Mountains and the Mediterranean. Capital: Tarsus.
importancia_estrategica: Roman province; homeland of Paul of Tarsus; gate between Asia Minor and Syria.

historias.titulo: Paul was born in Tarsus of Cilicia
historias.descripcion: Paul of Tarsus, 'citizen of Tarsus, a not insignificant city of Cilicia', used his Roman citizenship born in that province for his mission.

historias.titulo: The Cilician Gates: Gate from Asia to Syria
historias.descripcion: The mountain pass of Cilicia (Cilician Gates) was decisive in the campaigns of Alexander the Great and the routes of Paul.
Paul confirms the churches of Syria and Cilicia on their second missionary journey.

personajes.descripcion: Born in Tarsus in Cilicia; His Roman citizenship and Hellenistic training were born in this region.
Client king of Rome; He unified Cilicia under his rule.
He accompanied Paul in strengthening the churches of Cilicia.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Cilicia was the homeland of Paul; Its character as a crossroads between East and West shaped the greatest missionary of the NT.

cristianismo.descripcion: Paul proudly identifies himself as a citizen of Tarsus; The Hellenized Cilician culture forms the apostle who would bring the gospel to the Greco-Roman world.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Paul proudly identifies himself as a citizen of Tarsus; The Hellenized Cilician culture forms the apostle who would bring the gospel to the Greco-Roman world.

historias.titulo: Paul returns to Cilicia after his conversion
historias.descripcion: After his conversion and period in Damascus, Paul returned to Cilicia (Tarsus) where he stayed for several years.

historias.titulo: Barnabas goes to find Paul in Tarsus
historias.descripcion: Barnabas travels to Tarsus in Cilicia to find Paul and bring him to Antioch.

historias.titulo: Confirmation of the churches of Cilicia
historias.descripcion: Paul and Silas confirm the churches of Syria and Cilicia on the second journey.

personajes.descripcion: He was born and educated in Tarsus of Cilicia.
He traveled to Tarsus to gather Paul and bring him to Antioch.
He confirmed with Paul the Cilic churches on the second trip.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Cilicia is the homeland of the apostle Paul and the starting point of his formation as a bridge between the Jewish and Greco-Roman worlds.

cristianismo.descripcion: Tarsus of Cilicia formed the man who would bring the gospel to the Roman world: Roman citizen, diaspora Jew, Hellenist.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Tarsus of Cilicia formed the man who would bring the gospel to the Roman world: Roman citizen, diaspora Jew, Hellenist.
